name: 1/8 no Sentaku
source:
"...Just where did she go?"

Carelessly letting the cat she's been taking care of slip out of her home, the protagonist is running around looking for her...

Where she'll go and who she'll meet as a result...is all up to fate.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/25615]Freem![/url]]
